c: Seraphic Cry summons an array of seraphs over enemies which shoot down a holy yellow light beam from the sky, each creating a yellow shockwave at the point of impact that deals Area-of-Effect damage. Increases to
of each shockwave and increases the Interval between each beam.
increases the damage of this weapon up to a maximum of 11x at +900% Luck.

Rosaries while Seraphic Cry is present also transforms them into Weird Souls Purifiers. Weird Souls Purifiers create four screen-clearing explosions. The drop weight of Rosaries is also multiplied by 3 while Seraphic Cry is present, making them drop more often from light sources and
By default, it has a chance to deal critical hits, which deal 2x damage and have a 5% chance to occur. This chance is affected by Luck.
With Limit Break, Seraphic Cry can be further leveled up.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
